name: GreenCard UAT
instructions:
What GreenCard is
A website and phone app for Kerala restaurants. The public browse restaurants and jobs. Workers get a Green Card (an ID with a QR code and their verified work history). Restaurants hire, manage staff, licences and medical cards, get the POS and order from suppliers. The GreenCard admin approves restaurants and runs checks.

The three logins
• Admin: the GreenCard team (web only).
• Restaurant: the owner of a restaurant.
• Employee: a worker / job seeker (signs in with a phone code).
The public need no login.

Order
1. Getting started: everyone, just the logins.
2. Setup: Sana, on the admin login. Everything else stays locked until it's done.
3. Then everyone tests their own sections at the same time.
4. Last day: access checks and the full journey together.

Rules for testing together
• Use only the 3 demo restaurants (Saravana Bhavan, Paragon Restaurant, Café Lota) unless a test says to create one.
• Start anything new you create with your initial: S - , F - , M - .
• Phone codes: this is a test server, so no SMS is sent. The code shows on screen as 'Dev code'. Use a new made-up 10-digit phone number each time a test says 'new phone'.
• Change Settings only in your own Settings tests, and put them back.

How to mark
• Pass: it did what 'Should happen' says.
• Fail: it did something wrong. Write what you did and saw, add a screenshot.
• Blocked: you couldn't test it (error page, missing data, POS not reachable).
• Use Chrome on a laptop; your phone for the app and QR scanning.

tests.title: Open the site
steps: Open the GreenCard site in Chrome.
Look at the home page, then open Restaurants and Jobs from the top menu.
tests.expected: The home page loads with no login. Restaurants and Jobs lists show the demo restaurants and their jobs.

tests.title: Sign in as a restaurant
steps: Click Sign in. The page says 'Sign in or create account'.
Enter your restaurant login from the logins sheet (Email address + Password) → Sign in.
tests.expected: You land on the restaurant console (/restaurant) with 'Hi, <restaurant name>!' and the left menu: Dashboard, Jobs, Employees, Medical cards, Profile, Menu, Licenses, POS, Suppliers, Complaints, Notifications.

tests.title: Sign out and sign in with a one-time code
steps: Sign out.
On the sign-in page click 'Use a one-time code instead', enter the same restaurant's email or phone → Send code.
Type the code (shown as 'Dev code' on this test server) → Verify & continue.
tests.expected: You are signed in to the same restaurant console.

tests.title: Wrong password
steps: Sign out. Sign in with the right email and a wrong password.
tests.expected: A clear 'wrong email or password' type message. You stay on the sign-in page; nothing else is revealed.

tests.title: Admin sign-in
steps: Sign in with the admin login from the logins sheet.
tests.expected: You land on /admin with 'Hi, Admin!' and the menu groups Network, Trust & safety, Operations, and Settings at the bottom.

tests.title: Demo restaurants are approved
steps: Restaurants → Approved tab.
tests.expected: Saravana Bhavan, Paragon Restaurant and Café Lota are listed as Approved.

tests.title: Connect the POS
steps: Operations → POS. Scroll to Connection.
POS admin address: the POS admin address from the logins sheet. Shared secret: from the logins sheet. → Save connection.
tests.expected: Saved. The Shared secret box now shows 'Set — leave empty to keep' (the secret is never shown again). The Plans box lists the POS plans (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with prices.

tests.title: Add two suppliers
steps: Operations → Suppliers → Suppliers tab → Add supplier.
Supplier 1: Business name 'S - Fresh Veg Co', Type Vegetables & fruit, Contact person, Phone, WhatsApp (your own number), Email (your own), Areas 'Kochi', tick 'Show to restaurants'. Save.
Supplier 2: 'S - Gas Agency', Type Gas, phone only (no email, no WhatsApp), tick 'Show to restaurants'. Save.
tests.expected: Both appear in the table with status Live.

tests.title: Supplier needs a contact
steps: Add supplier: fill only Business name and Type, leave phone, WhatsApp and email empty. Save.
tests.expected: Not saved. A message asks for at least one of phone, WhatsApp or email.

tests.title: Settings are write-only
steps: Settings. Look at the Google, SMTP, MSG91 and similar secret fields.
tests.expected: Secret fields never show the saved value back (blank or 'set'). Site identity and contact details load. Change nothing.

tests.title: Browse restaurants
steps: Signed out, open Restaurants. Search for 'Paragon'. Open it.
tests.expected: Search finds it. The page shows photos, address, cuisines and the menu. No sign-in is asked for.

tests.title: Browse jobs
steps: Open Jobs. Open any job.
tests.expected: The job shows title, restaurant, pay/details. Clicking Apply asks you to sign in (it doesn't apply as a guest).

tests.title: Malayalam and Hindi
steps: Switch the language to Malayalam, then Hindi (or open /ml and /hi).
Visit home, Restaurants and Jobs in each.
tests.expected: Menus and buttons change language. Note any English text left over, or broken layout, as a Fail with a screenshot.

tests.title: Trust and privacy pages
steps: Open the Trust page and the Privacy policy from the footer.
tests.expected: Both pages load with real text (no placeholder or 'lorem ipsum').

tests.title: Suspended restaurant is hidden
steps: Do this after REG-07 (a restaurant has been suspended). Signed out, search Restaurants for it.
tests.expected: The suspended restaurant does not appear in the public list, and its old link shows not found.

tests.title: Phone layout
steps: Open the site on your phone's browser. Visit home, Restaurants, a restaurant, Jobs, a job.
tests.expected: Everything fits the screen; no sideways scrolling; buttons are easy to tap.

tests.title: A restaurant signs up
steps: Signed out, click 'Run a restaurant? / List your restaurant'.
Verify your phone with a new phone (use the Dev code).
Tell us about your venue: Restaurant name 'F - Test Kitchen', Email (a new made-up one), Password, Address, Cuisines → submit.
tests.expected: You land on the restaurant console. A banner says 'Your restaurant is under review. Upload your FSSAI / trade licence below…'.

tests.title: Upload a licence while pending
steps: On the dashboard Documents panel: Type FSSAI licence, Number '12345678901234', upload a PDF or photo.
tests.expected: The document is listed. It is not public.

tests.title: Pending restaurant is not public
steps: In another browser (or incognito), signed out, search Restaurants for 'F - Test Kitchen'.
tests.expected: Not listed.

tests.title: Admin rejects with a reason
steps: Admin → Restaurants → Pending → open 'F - Test Kitchen'.
Click Reject with an empty reason, then with 'ab', then with 'Licence photo unreadable'.
tests.expected: Empty and 2-letter reasons are refused (at least 3 characters). The full reason works; status becomes Rejected. The owner's dashboard now says 'Your registration was rejected.' Note whether the owner got any email or notification (known gap: none is sent).

tests.title: Admin approves
steps: Sign up a second restaurant 'F - Test Cafe' as in REG-01.
Admin → Restaurants → Pending → open it → Approve.
tests.expected: Status Approved. It now appears in the public Restaurants list. The owner's banner is gone. Note whether the owner was told (known gap: no notification).

tests.title: Admin adds a restaurant
steps: Admin → Restaurants → Add a restaurant. Name 'F - Admin Added', an email you can read, tick 'Approve now' and 'Email the owner'. Save.
Sign in as that owner with a one-time code.
tests.expected: The restaurant is Approved straight away. A welcome email arrives. The owner gets in with a one-time code.

tests.title: Suspend and reactivate
steps: Admin → open 'F - Test Cafe' → Suspend with reason 'UAT test'.
Sign in as its owner and look at the dashboard.
Admin → Reactivate.
tests.expected: While suspended: owner sees 'Your restaurant is suspended. Contact support.' and it's gone from the public list. After reactivating it's back.

tests.title: Edit on behalf of a restaurant
steps: Admin → open 'F - Test Cafe' → Edit business details (change the phone), Photos (add a cover photo), Documents → Upload on behalf.
Sign in as the owner and look at Profile.
tests.expected: The owner sees the new phone, cover photo and document.

tests.title: Edit profile
steps: Restaurant login (Paragon) → Profile. Change the description and opening hours. Save.
Open the restaurant's public page signed out.
tests.expected: The public page shows the change. Put the old text back afterwards.

tests.title: Add a menu item
steps: Menu → add an item 'F - Masala Tea', price ₹25, in a category. Save.
Open the public page.
tests.expected: The item shows on the public menu with ₹25.

tests.title: Edit and remove a menu item
steps: Change 'F - Masala Tea' to ₹30, then delete it.
tests.expected: Public menu shows ₹30, then the item is gone.

tests.title: Licences
steps: Licenses → add a Trade licence with a number and expiry date next month.
Click to reveal the full number.
tests.expected: Saved. The number is masked until revealed. (Revealing is recorded in the admin Audit log, checked in ADM-04.)

tests.title: Dashboard tiles
steps: Dashboard. Click each tile: Menu, Employees, Open jobs, Medical cards, Complaints, POS, and each quick action (Post a job, Add employee, Look up card, Order supplies).
tests.expected: Each count is right and each goes to the matching page.

tests.title: Worker signs up with a phone
steps: Signed out → Sign in → enter a new phone → Send code → type the Dev code → Verify & continue.
tests.expected: A new worker account is made and you land on My profile with a prompt to create your Green Card.

tests.title: Can't apply before the profile
steps: Before creating the profile, open a job and click Apply.
tests.expected: Refused with a message to create your Green Card profile first.

tests.title: Create the Green Card profile
steps: Start the profile: name 'M - Test Worker', details, then the selfie (liveness) step with your laptop camera or the phone app.
tests.expected: The selfie can't be skipped. After it, My profile shows a unique Green Card ID and a QR code. Card status is inactive/unverified (correct until hired and verified).

tests.title: Edit profile
steps: My profile → edit: add skills/experience, change photo. Save.
tests.expected: Saved and shown on the profile.

tests.title: Health card self-declaration
steps: Medical card → 'I already have a card' → upload a photo of a (sample) card with an expiry date.
tests.expected: The card shows as 'Uploaded — valid' (or waits for a check) with its expiry.

tests.title: Privacy centre
steps: Privacy → look at consents, request a data export. Do NOT delete the account.
tests.expected: Consents are listed. The export is offered/downloaded.

tests.title: Identity after hiring
steps: Do this after HIR-03 (you have been hired). Restaurant (Saravana) → Employees → your worker → attest in-person ID.
Admin → Identity checks: approve it if it's waiting there.
tests.expected: Before hiring, identity checks are refused. After attesting (and admin approval if needed), the worker's journey shows ID checked → Identity verified and the card becomes active.

tests.title: Post a job
steps: Restaurant (Saravana) → Jobs → post 'M - Waiter', salary, details. Leave 'requires health card' off. Publish.
tests.expected: The job shows in the restaurant's list and on the public Jobs page.

tests.title: Worker applies
steps: As the worker from WRK-03 → Jobs → 'M - Waiter' → Apply.
tests.expected: Applied. It shows under Applications as Applied.

tests.title: Review and hire
steps: Restaurant → Jobs → 'M - Waiter' → applicants: move to Reviewed, then Shortlisted, then Hire. Type the code the worker gets (Dev code).
tests.expected: Worker's Applications shows each status change and gets a notification ('Your job application is now: …'). After Hire, the worker is in Employees and their Green Card shows Saravana Bhavan in work history.

tests.title: Health-card gated job
steps: Post 'M - Cook' with 'requires health card' on.
Apply with a worker who has no valid health card, then with one who has (WRK-05).
tests.expected: Without a valid card: refused with a clear message. With one: applied.

tests.title: Add a walk-in employee
steps: Restaurant → Employees → add a walk-in employee with a new phone.
tests.expected: The employee is listed. They can sign in with that phone and see the restaurant in their history.

tests.title: Hire by Green Card ID
steps: Restaurant (Café Lota) → Employees → hire by Green Card ID: type the worker's ID from WRK-03.
Check the preview, confirm. The worker approves (in-app or with the Dev code).
tests.expected: The preview shows the right person. After approval, the worker is at Café Lota and the Saravana job is closed automatically in their history.

tests.title: Look up a Green Card
steps: Restaurant (Paragon) → Look up card → enter the worker's Green Card ID.
tests.expected: Shows the verified history allowed for a non-employer. The worker gets a notification that Paragon looked them up.

tests.title: Bulk import staff
steps: Restaurant → Employees → Bulk import staff → Download template (.xlsx). Fill 3 staff with new phones. Upload, tick the consent, confirm.
tests.expected: 3 employees added. Admin → Bulk imports lists the batch. Wrong rows (bad phone) are reported, not silently skipped.

tests.title: Close a job and an employment
steps: Close the 'M - Waiter' job. Then Employees → open the walk-in from HIR-05 → close tenure.
tests.expected: The job disappears from the public list. The employee's history shows an end date; past records can't be edited or deleted.

tests.title: Worker requests a medical card
steps: As a worker → Medical card → Request a medical card.
tests.expected: Status Requested.

tests.title: Admin approves and assigns a lab
steps: Admin → Labs: check at least one lab exists (add 'M - Test Lab' with your email if none).
Medical cards → the request → Approve → pick the lab → record the fee as Cash.
tests.expected: Status moves Approved → At the lab. The lab gets an email. The worker sees the change.

tests.title: Issue the card
steps: Medical cards → the request → Issue (enter card number and expiry).
tests.expected: Status Issued. The worker's profile shows a valid health card. The restaurant employing them sees it on the employee page.

tests.title: Reject and cancel
steps: Make two more requests. Reject one, cancel the other.
tests.expected: Rejected and Cancelled show for the worker with no card issued.

tests.title: Restaurant medical cards page
steps: Restaurant → Medical cards.
tests.expected: Lists its employees' card status and expiry; expiring-soon ones stand out.

tests.title: Restaurant files a complaint
steps: Restaurant → Complaints → new complaint about one of its employees, with a short description and a photo.
tests.expected: Complaint is Open. The worker is notified.

tests.title: Worker responds
steps: As that worker → Complaints → open it → add a response with evidence.
tests.expected: Status Under response. The response can't be edited or deleted afterwards.

tests.title: Admin decides
steps: Admin → Complaints → open it → decide (Verified / Disputed / Removed).
tests.expected: Both sides see the decision. It shows in the Audit log.

tests.title: Dispute a work record
steps: Worker → My profile → a work record → dispute it.
Admin → Complaints → record disputes → review → uphold or reject.
tests.expected: Status moves open → reviewing → upheld/rejected. The original record is not deleted.

tests.title: Notification centre
steps: As worker and as restaurant, open the bell / Notifications. Click a notification.
tests.expected: The events from the tests above are there, newest first, and clicking one opens the right page and marks it read.

tests.title: Restaurant sees the plans
steps: Restaurant (Café Lota) → Dashboard → 'Get the POS' card → See plans.
tests.expected: /restaurant/pos shows 'Choose a POS plan' with each plan's price per month/year + GST, limits, modules and hardware add-ons. Ticking hardware updates the monthly-bill preview.

tests.title: Start a free trial
steps: On a plan card → 'Start 14-day free trial' → Yes, start.
tests.expected: The page turns into the plan view: Your plan, status, Paid until (today + 14 days), days left, and an 'Open POS' button.

tests.title: Open POS (single sign-on)
steps: Click Open POS.
tests.expected: A new tab opens the restaurant's POS, already signed in as the owner, with no password asked.

tests.title: The Open POS link is one-time
steps: In the POS tab, copy the address it first opened (…/greencard-login/…) before it redirects, or from history.
Sign out of the POS and paste that address again. Also try a fresh link after waiting over 60 seconds.
tests.expected: Reused or expired link shows not found. A fresh Open POS click works.

tests.title: Enquire about a plan
steps: Restaurant (Paragon) → POS → on a plan, tick a hardware add-on → Enquire. Then use 'Ask a question' to send a second one.
tests.expected: First enquiry shows under 'Your enquiries' as Waiting, with the hardware. The second is refused: 'You already have an enquiry waiting…'.

tests.title: Admin handles the enquiry
steps: Admin → POS → 'POS enquiries (1 new)' → Mark contacted, then Close, then Reopen.
tests.expected: Tabs New / Contacted / Closed move it correctly. Paragon sees its status change.

tests.title: Admin gives the POS
steps: Admin → POS → 'Give a restaurant the POS' → search Paragon → Open.
Choose a plan (Pro), Billing cycle Monthly, POS address 'f-paragon' → Give the POS.
tests.expected: Paragon now shows under 'Restaurants with the POS' as Active with a Paid until date. Its open enquiry is closed automatically. Paragon's POS page shows the plan and Open POS.

tests.title: POS address rules
steps: Give the POS to the restaurant from REG-06 and try addresses 'ab', '1cafe', 'Cafe!' and 'admin', then a good one.
tests.expected: The bad ones are refused (3–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter; 'admin' is reserved). The good one works.

tests.title: Change plan and renew
steps: Admin → POS → Paragon → Manage. Switch the plan to Basic. Save changes.
Renew by one month. Save changes.
tests.expected: Plan shows Basic on both GreenCard and the POS. Paid until moves forward by one month from the old date.

tests.title: Pause and reactivate the POS
steps: Pause the POS with reason 'UAT pause' → Pause POS. Paragon owner clicks Open POS.
Try Pause with an empty reason on another restaurant.
Reactivate POS.
tests.expected: Paused: the POS shows a paused page with the reason. Empty reason should be refused (known gap: it is accepted — mark Fail if so). After Reactivate, Open POS works again.

tests.title: Owner's bill and invoices
steps: Paragon → POS. Look at 'Your monthly bill', 'Hardware', 'Invoices' and 'How to pay'.
tests.expected: Monthly bill matches the plan (+ any hardware), GST shown. UPI ID has a Copy button. No sales or order data from the POS appears anywhere on GreenCard.

tests.title: Not approved = no POS
steps: Sign in as the rejected 'F - Test Kitchen' (REG-04) → POS. Try Start free trial and Enquire.
Suspend Café Lota (admin), then as Café Lota click Open POS. Reactivate afterwards.
tests.expected: Start trial and Open POS are refused with a clear reason. Note if Enquire still works for a not-approved restaurant (known gap).

tests.title: Wrong shared secret
steps: Admin → POS → Connection: save a wrong 40-character secret. Reload POS.
Put the right secret back and save.
tests.expected: With the wrong secret the panels say to check the shared secret, without crashing. With the right one the plans load again.

tests.title: Restaurant finds a supplier
steps: Restaurant (Saravana) → Suppliers. Use the search and the category chips.
tests.expected: Both live suppliers from SU-04 show with call / WhatsApp / email icons. Filtering by Gas shows only the gas agency.

tests.title: Send an order request
steps: 'S - Fresh Veg Co' → Send request. Items: Onion 10 kg, Tomato 5 kg (Add item). Deliver on: tomorrow. Note. → Send request.
Try a past date first.
tests.expected: Past date refused. Request saved under 'Your requests' as Sent; an email arrives at the supplier's email; a WhatsApp tab opens with the order text ready.

tests.title: Supplier with only a phone
steps: Send a request to 'S - Gas Agency'.
tests.expected: Request saved. Check the message shown: it should not promise the supplier 'will see it' when there's no email or WhatsApp (known gap). Note what it says.

tests.title: Request statuses
steps: On the veg request: Supplier confirmed → Received. On another request: Cancel.
tests.expected: Statuses Sent → Confirmed → Delivered; Cancel only offered while Sent. Admin's Requests tab shows the same.

tests.title: Admin manages requests and suppliers
steps: Admin → Suppliers → Requests tab: filter New / Confirmed / Delivered / Cancelled.
Suppliers tab: Turn off 'S - Gas Agency'. Try to delete 'S - Fresh Veg Co'.
tests.expected: Filters work. The turned-off supplier disappears for restaurants. Delete is refused because it has requests.

tests.title: Not approved can't order
steps: As the rejected 'F - Test Kitchen' → Suppliers → Send request.
tests.expected: Sending is refused with a clear reason.

tests.title: Dashboard and analytics
steps: Open Dashboard and Analytics.
tests.expected: Counts (restaurants by status, workers, jobs) match what you see in the lists.

tests.title: Users: suspend and force sign-out
steps: Users → find the worker from WRK-01 → force logout, then suspend. Worker tries to sign in. Then activate.
tests.expected: Worker is signed out; while suspended they can't sign in; after activate they can.

tests.title: Employee registry is masked
steps: Employees → open a worker.
tests.expected: Phone and ID numbers are masked.

tests.title: Audit log
steps: Audit log. Find the approve/reject/suspend actions from REG and the licence reveal from RST-04. Export CSV.
tests.expected: Each action is listed with who and when. The CSV downloads and opens in Excel.

tests.title: Face duplicates and identity queue
steps: Open Face duplicates and Identity checks.
tests.expected: Pages load; any items can be decided (Different people / Same person — duplicate; approve/reject). On this test server face matching is simulated, so an empty list is fine.

tests.title: Promotions
steps: Promotions → feature Café Lota on the home page. Check the home page signed out. Remove it.
tests.expected: Café Lota appears featured, then goes back to normal.

tests.title: Designations
steps: Designations → add 'S - Barista'. Use it when posting a job (as a restaurant). Then remove it if allowed.
tests.expected: The new designation is offered in the job form.

tests.title: Install and browse
steps: Install the test APK from the logins sheet. Open it.
tests.expected: Opens to Discover with restaurants and jobs; no sign-in wall.

tests.title: Worker sign-in on the app
steps: Sign in as the worker from WRK-03.
tests.expected: Shows the Green Card with QR, applications, medical card and notifications — same data as the website.

tests.title: Restaurant scan-to-hire
steps: Sign in on the app as Paragon → Manage → Scan. Scan the worker's Green Card QR (shown on another screen).
tests.expected: The worker's card opens with a hire option; the hire then needs the worker's approval.

tests.title: Admin can't use the app
steps: Try signing in on the app with the admin login.
tests.expected: Refused with a clear message (admin is web only).

tests.title: POS and suppliers on the app
steps: As a restaurant, look for POS and Suppliers in the app menu.
tests.expected: Known gap: not in the app yet. Mark Blocked with the note 'not in app' — this is for the record, not a bug to fix now.

tests.title: Restaurant can't open admin pages
steps: Signed in as a restaurant, type /admin, /admin/pos and /admin/suppliers in the address bar.
tests.expected: Sent back to the restaurant console. No admin data shown.

tests.title: Worker can't open restaurant pages
steps: Signed in as a worker, type /restaurant and /restaurant/pos.
tests.expected: Sent away. No restaurant data shown.

tests.title: Signed out can't open consoles
steps: Signed out, open /admin and /restaurant.
tests.expected: Sent to the sign-in page.

tests.title: One restaurant can't see another's
steps: As Saravana, open an employee page and copy its address. Sign in as Paragon and open that address.
tests.expected: Not found / not allowed. Paragon never sees Saravana's staff, jobs' applicants, enquiries or supplier requests.

tests.title: Password reset
steps: Sign-in page → Forgot password? → your restaurant email → follow the code (Dev code) → set a new password → sign in. Put the old password back afterwards.
tests.expected: Works end to end; the old password stops working until changed back.

sections.name: Full journey (do together at the end)

tests.title: From sign-up to POS
steps: Sana (admin), Fathima (restaurant), Mithra (worker), one after the other:
1. Fathima signs up a new restaurant 'Team Cafe' and uploads an FSSAI licence.
2. Sana approves it.
3. Fathima posts a job; Mithra signs up with a new phone, makes a Green Card and applies.
4. Fathima hires Mithra and attests her ID; Mithra's card becomes active.
5. Fathima starts a POS free trial and clicks Open POS; in the POS she adds a menu item and makes one order.
6. Fathima sends an order request to 'S - Fresh Veg Co'; Sana marks it confirmed.
7. Sana pauses the POS; Fathima sees the paused page; Sana reactivates.
tests.expected: Every step works without help and each person sees the right status at each step. Write down anything confusing even if it worked.
